system.description:
Acquired with CR 11 or higher. Target all characters who have just received HP Damage from an attack. The target recovers +[Magic Power] HP. This skill may only be used once in response to a single attack.

(Fate 1): Increase the amount of HP recovered by +[POW mod].

A magic that spreads a healing force field over a wide area in response to enemy attacks. The healing power that can now be deployed over a wider area will enable the rebuilding of fighting strength against various troublesome attacks.
